observations.rationale: High cart abandonment (45% current vs 30% target) is driven by legacy checkout system causing performance failures and payment errors. Customers abandon at the payment step rather than from purchase intent change.

evidence.excerpt: Cart Abandonment Rate 45% vs 30% target (Objectives_Key_Results). Pain point: 'Legacy checkout system causing performance and payment failures' (High urgency, Immediate).

observations.rationale: CRM data is fragmented across online and in-store systems following a failed GDPR implementation. Customer profiles are incomplete (75% vs 95% target), preventing personalised recommendations and cross-channel continuity.

evidence.excerpt: Customer profile completeness 75% vs 95% target. Pain points: 'Broken CRM data due to failed GDPR implementation' (High, Immediate) and 'Customer data fragmentation preventing personalized engagement' (High, Short-Term).

observations.rationale: Current delivery lead time of 5 days is significantly behind competitor next-day delivery capability. Fulfillment channel allocation is partially manual, creating routing delays particularly for high-demand SKUs.

evidence.excerpt: Delivery Lead Time 5 days vs 2 day target. Competitor pain point: 'Competitors offer next-day delivery; we take 5 days' (High, Immediate, Behind). Pain point: 'Competitors use automated order fulfillment; our process is partially manual' (High, Short-Term).

observations.rationale: Discount and promotional pricing decisions are made independently across in-store, online, and B2B channels with no unified pricing authority. This creates inconsistent customer experiences and margin leakage when customers cross channels to exploit pricing differences.

evidence.excerpt: Pricing Policy governs three separate activities across two VS without unified governance. Pain point: 'Competitor pricing algorithms personalize discounts dynamically; we use static pricing' (High, Short-Term, Behind). Gross Margin target 45% vs 40% current.

observations.rationale: New sustainability regulations are creating compliance obligations across product selection, supplier onboarding, and order documentation. Compliance gatekeeping has not been integrated into existing operational flows, creating ad-hoc review overhead.

evidence.excerpt: Pain point: 'New sustainability regulations increasing compliance complexity' (Medium, Long-Term, High resolution complexity). Business Outcome: 'Order Documents Display Circular Products for Transparency' (Positioning theme).

bindingConstraint.justification: Fragmented pricing authority is the single governing constraint that spans all three value streams simultaneously. It creates inconsistent customer experiences across channels (fo_003), prevents dynamic discount capability that competitors use to drive conversion (fo_001), and slows B2B agreement execution where non-standard pricing requires multi-step approval (fo_007). Unlike execution friction (checkout system, delivery lead time) which can be fixed independently per stream, pricing authority fragmentation requires a structural governance change affecting all three streams at once — making it the binding constraint on enterprise-wide conversion improvement.
